description: This file defines the PasswordStrengthService class in the OrangeHRM project, responsible for password policy enforcement, validation, and reset mechanisms within the authentication system.
external_files: OrangeHRM	he specific config DAO or config service classes
OrangeHRM	he specific DAO for EnforcePasswordDao
OrangeHRM	he User class in entity

classes.name: PasswordStrengthService
classes.description: Service class providing password policy validation, generation, enforcement, and reset functionality for the orangehrm authentication module.

methods.name: getEnforcePasswordDao
methods.description: Returns an instance of the EnforcePasswordDao for managing enforced password requests.

methods.name: getMinLength
methods.description: Retrieves the minimum password length from configuration.

methods.name: getMaxLength
methods.description: Retrieves the maximum password length from configuration.

methods.name: getMinNoOfLowercaseLetters
methods.description: Retrieves the required minimum number of lowercase letters from configuration.

methods.name: getMinNoOfUppercaseLetters
methods.description: Retrieves the required minimum number of uppercase letters from configuration.

methods.name: getMinNoOfNumbers
methods.description: Retrieves the minimum number of numeric characters required in a password.

methods.name: getMinNoOfSpecialCharacters
methods.description: Retrieves the minimum number of special characters required.

methods.name: getIsSpacesAllowed
methods.description: Indicates whether spaces are permitted in passwords based on configuration.

methods.name: getDefaultPasswordStrength
methods.description: Returns the default password strength level from configuration.

methods.name: checkMinPasswordLength
methods.description: Checks if the password meets the minimum length requirement.

methods.name: checkMaxPasswordLength
methods.description: Checks if the password exceeds the maximum length.

methods.name: checkMinLowercaseLetters
methods.description: Verifies if the password contains at least the minimum number of lowercase letters.

methods.name: checkMinUppercaseLetters
methods.description: Verifies if the password contains at least the minimum number of uppercase letters.

methods.name: checkMinNumbersInPassword
methods.description: Verifies if the password contains at least the minimum number of digits.

methods.name: checkMinSpecialCharacters
methods.description: Verifies if the password contains at least the minimum number of special characters.

methods.name: checkSpacesInPassword
methods.description: Checks for disallowed spaces in the password.

methods.name: checkRequiredDefaultPasswordStrength
methods.description: Checks if the password strength level meets the default policy requirements.

methods.name: checkPasswordPolicies
methods.description: Validates the password against all configured password policies and returns messages for violations.

methods.name: isValidPassword
methods.description: Determines if a password adheres to all policy requirements.

methods.name: generateEnforcePasswordResetCode
methods.description: Generates a unique reset code for enforcing password reset.

methods.name: logPasswordEnforceRequest
methods.description: Creates and logs a password enforce request, returning the reset code.

methods.name: validateUrl
methods.description: Validates the provided reset code URL for expiry and existence.

methods.name: isResetCodeTimeOut
methods.description: Checks if the reset code has timed out based on a 1-hour window.

methods.name: getUserNameByResetCode
methods.description: Retrieves the username associated with a given reset code.

methods.name: validateUser
methods.description: Validates user object, ensuring it is active and not terminated.

methods.name: saveEnforcedPassword
methods.description: Saves an enforced password for a user, validating and starting a transaction.
